key_reasoning.reason: Effort propagates through 4+ production touchpoints across distinct subsystems: assistant-page components (AssistantForm, AssistantSetupSection, AssistantDetailsSidebarSections), workflow-editor components (AssistantTab, VirtualAssistantForm), a new shared util (effortConstraints.ts mirroring temperatureConstraints.ts), the global appInfo Valtio store, the assistant DTO transform (store/utils/assistants.ts), and three type-definition files. Red flags for 'touches core shared utilities' and 'affects multiple workflows/agents' both apply (effortConstraints/VALIDATION_CONSTRAINTS reused by both AssistantSetupSection and VirtualAssistantForm; the feature spans both the standalone Assistant form and the workflow editor's virtual-assistant tab), pushing the score to the XXL cap.

diffstat reports 40 files changed, 2314 insertions(+) — well above the 16+ threshold for XXL — even though only 23 of those (13 production + 10 test files) were enumerated in changed_files for direct inspection; the remainder are additional test/support files captured only in the aggregate diffstat.
